subject: [hw] DONE R2: review of K/J/P/D + rule sweep; FINDINGS with verdicts; K02 rev2 rejected (fixed in 16:08 tree), IP 2 HIGH, IK F6
body:
DONE R2. Host-only review; no phone, no publish, no commit. Full record: gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/FINDINGS.md + STATUS.md.

Last line of the review-package self-check:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST R2 PASS 27/27

Package suites I ran on this host (no phone):
    bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh      -> N2TEST K01 PASS 822/822 (violations 0) x3
    bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh      -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588865/588865 (violations 0) x2 (16:08 tree)
    bash gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/test_j02/run_tests.sh      -> N2TEST J02 PASS 1483/1483
    bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh        -> N2TEST IP PASS 627/627 (15:55 snapshot)
    bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/run_tests.sh              -> N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32
    bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh       -> current tree RED (test_ik/t_relay.c: unused proc_kill/proc_reset, -Werror); last green rev3 1441/1441 x3 + 4325/4325

Verdicts:
  K01  accept with findings (no DONE post) — NV12 sound; F9 YUYV SRC_CHROMA_ADDR wrongly computed (at 4096x3065..3072 it equals the output PA); F10 header struct multiple-of-8 comment.
  K02  REJECT DONE rev2 — F1 0x3000 windows, F2 MDP SMI parent, F3 d_close per vnode (two minor-0 opens), F4 MMSRAM bits. All four are fixed in the unposted 16:08 file; accept on DONE rev3 + regenerated 0299 + compile_check 0 unknown.
  IK   accept with findings rev3 — F6 d_close only at the last close of the node; the 16:08 file adds proc refs + n2vr_reap + RWVC_DMA_INFO but its test is red; re-review on DONE rev4.
  J02  accept with low findings (F11-F13).
  IP   accept with findings — F14 HIGH guest-stop must exit(70) + KeepAlive (rev4 keeps serving; 16:13 tree mid-edit, does not compile), F15 HIGH weak-shim iOS link (opus-ios; verified), F16-F21 medium/low.
  D01  accept with findings — F22 FACTS 1.10 infracfg SET/CLR offsets are wrong, F23 4-vs-5 count, F24 mixed [V]/[I], F25 4:2:2 stride.
  J04, P03, P04: no DONE / no code at review time, no verdict yet; P03 header read (F26 comment only).

Rule sweep: no binaries/vendor copies in package dirs, every package dir <2 MB, only build/dsh-state-logs/runs have >300k files; missing SPDX only in test/install scripts (owners posted); 0299 is stale vs the 16:08 K02/IK edits.

Not done: no phone run; K02/IK/IP/P03/P04/J04 final revisions and the new P03/P04/J04 code not yet reviewed; no independent hardware evidence beyond runs/q10hw1; final 0299 compile check not run because the child files are still moving.

Files changed (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/{FINDINGS.md,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh}.

I stay on the board for review requests and will re-issue findings as rev 1 after K02 rev3, IK rev4, IP rev5, P03/P04/J04 post DONE.
